sample_unit: patients and caregivers (randomized); 40 abstracts, 600 generated sections

links.outcome: Patient/caregiver comprehension and perception of AI plain-language summaries vs original abstracts
links.effect: LAS recipients scored significantly better in comprehension and most perception questions (P<.001); readability 68.9 vs 25.3 (P<.001); LAS was the only consistently significant predictor.
links.quote: GAI-generated LAS recipients scored significantly better in comprehension and most perception-based questions (P < .001) with LAS being the only consistently significant predictor (P < .001).

links.outcome: Hallucination rate and accuracy of AI-generated lay summaries
links.effect: Hallucinations in 1% of sections; quality scores 85% to 100%; Methods sections had lower accuracy (85% vs 100%; P=.03).
links.quote: Quality scores ranged from 85% to 100%, with hallucinations in 1% of sections.

unlisted_practices: Generating plain-language lay summaries of medical research literature with generative AI for patients

screen.reason: The study tests the effectiveness of LLM-generated lay abstracts compared to original scientific abstracts on patient and caregiver comprehension and perception.
